 Hon'Ble Madan Pal Singh, J. 
1. Heard Sri Rajat Sonkar, Advocate holding brief of Sri Suresh Kumar Maurya, learned counsel for
the revisionists, Sri Amish Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the opposite party no.1 and
learned Aga for the State and perused the material available on record.

2. This criminal revision has been filed by the revisionists with a prayer to set aside the judgment
and order dated 28.05.2024 passed by the Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Jaunpur in
Case No. 110 of 2018 (Smt. Amrita Devi & Anr. Vs. Sanjay Kumar Patel) whereby the trial court has
rejected the application under Section 125 Cr.P.C. filed by the revisionists.

entities.text: Amrita Devi & Anr. Vs. Sanjay Kumar Patel
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3.  Learned counsel for the revisionists submitted that that trial court has rejected the application under Section 125 Cr.P.C. on the ground that revisionist no.1 has failed to proof herself as legally wedded wife of opposite party no. 1, Sanjay Kumar Patel.

It is further submitted that the application filed under Section 125 Cr.P.C. by the revisionists before trial court has categorically mentioned that the marriage of revisionist no. 1 was solemnized with opposite party no.1 in May, 2005 according to Hindu rites and rituals in Gauri Shanker Temple, Sujanganj, District- Jaunpur and sufficient article were given in the said marriage by the parents of the revisionist no.1 and Rs. 51,000/- was also given in cash.
4.

Learned counsel for the revisionists also submitted that the revisionist no.1 has examined her uncle as P.W.-2 who supported the version of the revisionist and stated in his examination-in-chief that the marriage of revisionist no. 1 was solemnized with Sanjay Kumar Patel in Gauri Shanker Temple, Sujanganj, District- Jaunpur and thereafter she went with her husband to her matrimonial house and started living together happily as husband and wife but this fact has not been considered by the trial court while deciding the application under Section 125 Cr.P.C. filed by the revisionists and assumed that revisionist no.1 have failed to proved her marriage with the opposite party no.1.
5.

Learned counsel for the revisionists further submitted that trial court has not passed any order to get the DNA test of revisionist no. 2, this fact would be clear that who is biological father of the revisionist no. 2.
Without conducting DNA examination, the trial court has rejected the application under Section 125 Cr.P.C. which is arbitrary and against the law.

6. On the other hand, learned counsel for the opposite party no.1 has opposed the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the revisionists and states that marriage of opposite party no. 1 (Sanjay Kumar Patel) had been solemnized with Indu Devi D/o Ramsundar Patel on 09.06.2001.

It is further submitted that the marriage of revisionist no.1 was solemnized with one Ajay Patel @
Chhotu, r/o Rohiyan Saidani, P.S. Mungra Badshahpur, District- Jaunpur and from that wedlock revisionist no. 2 was born.

7. It is further submitted that in an application under Section 125 Cr.P.C. filed by the revisionist no.
1, where she claimed that her marriage was performed with opposite party no. 1 Sanjay Kumar Patel in May, 2005, wherein the allegation of rape has been levelled against the opposite party no.1 by Amrita Devi And Another vs Sanjay Kumar Patel on 3 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159778790/
2 filing an application under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C. on 8.12.2009

sentences.text: , subsequently, Judicial Magistrate has directed to investigate the matter and submits its report.
After completion of investigation, the police had submitted a final report in the said matter.

Thereafter, revisionist no. 1 filed a protest petition, which was treated as a complaint case by the trial court, and her statement was recorded under Section 200 Cr.P.C.
8.

It is next submitted that when she claims that her marriage was solemnized with opposite party no.1 in the year 2005 how can she filed an application under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C. against the opposite party no.1 for the offence under Section 376 IPC in 2009, the tenure of the opposite party no.1, no FIR can be registered against the husband under Section 376 IPC, it means when this complaint under Section 156 (3) was filed by revisionist no.1, she was not married with the opposite party no.1.
It is also submitted that under Section 200 Cr.P.C. the revisionist no. 1 herself admitted that from the wedlock of her marriage with Sanjay Kumar Patel, a girl was born namely Anjali
who was also present at the time of the marriage

. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.1 next submits that the girl which is said to be born from the wedlock of the revisionist no. 1 and Sanjay Kumar Patel/opposite party no.1, how can this girl was participated in their marriage.

It is next submitted that the trial court has categorically recorded its finding on the issue while deciding the issue no.1 and the finding of the trial court based on the evidence and, this Court cannot appreciate the evidence being a revisional Court.

9. Learned A.G.A. for State has also adopted same averments made by learned counsel for the opposite party no.1.
10.

On considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the revisionists and learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 as well as learned A.G.A. and from the perusal of record, the trial court has decided the application under Section 125 Cr.P.C. has already decided issue no. 1 whether the revisionist no. 1 is legally wedded wife of the opposite party no.1 or not.

11. A perusal of the finding recorded by the trial court while deciding the issue no. 1, wherein it has been recorded that the statement of P.W.-2 examined on behalf of the revisionist no. 1 who has stated in his cross-examination that earlier marriage of Amrita (present revisionist no.1) was solemnized with Chhotu Patel, r/o Rohiyawa, Police Station- Mungra Badshahpur, District- Jaunpur and dissolution of her marriage was took place through a village panchayat settlement.
This evidence shows that the revisionist no.1 was earlier married with Chhotu Patel and she did not obtained any formal decree of divorce from any competent court.

It is also reflects from the record that revisionist no. 2, by list 54 Kha and 55 Kha/1 kha by which documents name of the father is mentioned as Sanjay Kumar Patel but the date of birth in the AADHAR Card was mentioned on 15.02.2008 while in her application under Section 125 Cr.P.C., in paragraph no. 6 that the revisionist no.2/Anjali was born in 2007 from the wedlock of revisionist no.1 and Sanjay Kumar Patel.

It was recorded by the trial court that in the statement under Section 200 Cr.P.C., the revisionist no.1 herself admitted that Anjali/opposite party no. 2 was present at the time marriage of revisionist no. 1 performed with opposite party no. 1/Sanjay Kumar Patel, other than, she claimed that opposite no.1/ Sanjay Kumar Patel is the biological father of Anjali as she was born from their Amrita Devi And Another vs Sanjay Kumar Patel on 3 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159778790/
3 wedlock i.e. revisionist no. 1 and Sanjay Kumar Patel/opposite party no.1.

sentences.text: Since the revisionist no. 1 herself claimed that her daughter revisionist no.2 was present in her marriage performed with Sanjay Kumar Patel, it cannot be possible that the revisionist no.2 could have been born from that wedlock.

12. Moreover, from the perusal of the record it also reflects in paragraph no. 13 at page no. 4 of the impugned judgment, during the cross examination of revisionist no. 1, she herself admitted that in 2009, she filed an application under Section 156 (3) Cr. P.C. against the present opposite party no. 1 under Section 376 IPC, in that investigation was made, which shows that on the one hand, she claimed that her marriage was solemnized with the opposite party no.1 in May, 2005 in the application filed under Section 125 Cr.P.C., on the other hand, she had filed an application before the Judicial Magistrate, Jaunpur in 2009 alleging therein the allegation of rape against the present opposite party no.1 which shows that at the time of filing of the complaint against the opposite party no. 1 under Section 376 IPC, the relationship between the parties were not as husband and wife and the allegation of rape cannot lie against the husband.
It is clear that there was no relationship between the parties as husband and wife.

13. From the perusal of the impugned judgment, it also reflects that husband of the revisionist no. 1 Chhotu Patel is still alive and revisionist no.1 did not obtained any formal decree of divorce from any competent court.
Moreover, the opposite party no.1 has solemnized marriage with Indu Devi on 09.06.2001 as recorded by the trial court and from this wedlock two children were born.
14. In such circumstances, no relation between revisionist no. 1 and opposite party no.1 can be presumed as husband and wife.
The findings recorded by the trial court are findings of fact and this Court being a revisional court, may not re-
appreciate the evidence to return its own finding unless the finding recorded by the court is perverse and against the facts and law.

15. During the course of arguments, the Court ask to the learned counsel for the revisionists that when the revisionist no.1 had claimed that her marriage was solemnized in 2005 with opposite party no.1 how can she made allegation of rape against her husband, the counsel for the revisionists could not answer the same.
It also reflects that revisionist no. 1 has not came with clean hands before the trial court as well as approach before this Court.
16. The findings recorded by the trial court are based on cogent and reliable evidence and suffer from no illegality or perversity.
Accordingly, this Court, in its revisional jurisdiction, finds no reason to take a different view.
The conclusion arrived at by the trial court that the revisionist no. 1 have failed to proof her marriage with opposite party no. 1.
Hence, the impugned order does not call for any interference by this Court.
17. The criminal revision lacks merit and, is accordingly, dismissed.

(Madan Pal Singh,J.) November 3, 2025 Akbar  Amrita Devi And Another vs Sanjay Kumar Patel on 3 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159778790/
